firstScreen.notes: 1440-first.jpg: 6-word outcome h1, trade+city eyebrow, one primary Call plus quieter Text, phone in the header, Sample proof line, signature (jamb frame + W1/W2 tags) in the hero. The next band does not peek (-0.5). 'tagged' collides with the left jamb. 390-first.jpg: hero buttons and proof below the fold, only the sticky bar acts.

distinctiveness.notes: Hex-tag schedule system does real work in hero (1440-first.jpg), key plan (1440-rm-full.jpg), process strip (1440-scroll-25.jpg), service tags (1440-scroll-50.jpg), price sheet, reviews (1440-scroll-75.jpg), footer (1440-full.jpg). Differs fully from siblings B and C. Eyebrow on every heading plus mono/middle-dot meta strings (-0.5).

type.notes: Spectral/Onest/JetBrains Mono accent, good scale contrast (1440-first.jpg), tabular prices (1440-full.jpg). Service-card and tool-note body ~14px muted grey (1440-scroll-50.jpg) (-0.5).

layout.notes: 1440-full.jpg: tones alternate well, no dark bands touching, asymmetric services grid. #area does two jobs, ZIP/towns plus office hours (-0.5). The process runs ~3.6 screens with big blank gaps between steps (1440-scroll-25.jpg).

photo.notes: 1440-rm-full.jpg / 390-rm-full.jpg: key-plan house is a northern brick split-level with deciduous trees, off-region for Sarasota (-1.0). Mixed grades across frames, saturated blue vs grey overcast (1440-full.jpg, -0.5). Signature frames and tags on real openings (+0.5).

copy.notes: Real trade nouns (sill pan, rough opening, SHGC), Sample labels everywhere (1440-full.jpg, 1440-scroll-75.jpg). Four names for the primary action: Start a schedule / Get my window schedule / Get my measured list / Start your window schedule (1440-first.jpg, 1440-full.jpg) (-0.5).

mobile.notes: 390-full.jpg: no overflow, stacked process cards with the strip folded into 2 columns, sticky bar. 390-first.jpg: first screen ends on body copy, hero actions and proof below the fold (-0.5 vs the 9 anchor).

a11y.notes: 1440-rm-full.jpg / 390-rm-full.jpg show every word and photo. Heading order clean, forced-colors block, labelled inputs. Focus not verifiable. 13px grey tool notes (1440-full.jpg) are the weakest text.

motion.notes: 1440-scroll-25.jpg: the strip ticks per step while the jamb drawing changes state, so motion explains the process. 9 hooks. 1440-full.jpg / 390-full.jpg: key-plan tags appear on blank coral before the photo's clip reveal (-0.5).

wow.notes: Schedule strip fills on scroll (1440-scroll-25.jpg), returns as the full navy price sheet (1440-full.jpg). The measure tool outputs a tagged schedule row in the signature's language (1440-full.jpg #measure).

polish.notes: SVG favicon + apple-touch, theme-color, OG, specific JSON-LD, hero preload, print + forced-colors, 2px radius system, designed 'Schedule closed.' footer (1440-full.jpg). Stray 4/6px radii are minor.

elevate.move: Make the key plan a second hero: a Florida house frame with every opening tagged, each tag opening its own schedule row, so the photo becomes a drawing sheet. Grade all frames as one Gulf-light shoot.

Compose the h1 and jamb frame as one piece: the h1 crosses onto the photo inside the frame, the W1 tag string lands on 'tagged', and the proof line plus the coral band peek within 900px. At 390, re-cut so photo + tag + one action sit above the fold.
